UPC

UNIVERSITAT POLITÈCNICA DE CATALUNYA BARCELONATECH

Seguretat TIC i Protecció de Dades

Communication between the students and the teaching staff, and between the students themselves.

• Completion of activities and access to the resources proposed by the teaching staff.

Lecturer assessment of students.

It should be borne in mind that if it is planned to process the personal data for a purpose other than the one that led to the collection, before the post processing the interested party must be provided with information on this other purpose and any additional pertinent information, for so that you can exercise your rights, among others and, where appropriate, that of not giving consent for this new purpose.

8. Information to be provided to students

The interested parties will have to be informed in two specific moments:

a) At the time of sending them an email with the link of the session.

b) At the time of login.

The basic data protection information to be provided is as follows:

Responsible for the treatment

Contact data of the data protection delegate

Goal of the treatment

Legal status

Recipients

Universitat Politècnica de Catalunya Name of the center or unit with a link to the web page to contact.

E-mail address of the subject coordinator (or list of teachers' addresses assigned to each specific group or test)

Universitat Politècnica de Catalunya. (https://www.upc.edu/normatives/ca/proteccio-dedades/normativa-europea-de-proteccio-de-dades/dadesde-contacte-del-delegat-de-proteccio-de-dades)

F03.21 Virtual campus management. (https://rat.upc.edu/ca/registre-de-tractaments-de-dadespersonals/F03.21) Sessió de classe / d'avaluació en remot (o sessions classe / avaluacions en remot de l'assignatura XXX) del centre XXX any 2020

Based on the fulfillment of a mission carried out in the public interest (Organic Law 6/2001, of December 21, on Universities)

Your first and last name or ID in the session will be visible to other participants when you attend the session.
